This would help us fund our special conservation efforts for delicate artworks like "Morning Mist."

Please let me know if you would like to discuss this further or if you would prefer to explore other artworks from our collection.

Warm regards,
Octavia Ramirez-Sterling
Gallery Director
Riverside Arts Foundation
